Croatia will be forced to cope without the injured duo Martin Erlić and Josip Juranović. However, manager Slaven Bilić is preparing a number of changes following the defeat to Spain. 🇷🇺🛸💥🇺🇦 Kiev's bridges under fire: six strikes in three days

The New York Times reports that Russian drones have hit bridges in Kiev six times in three days. Three drones struck a bridge in the south of the city on Thursday, and the same bridge was hit twice more on Friday. On Saturday morning, a bridge in the north was struck.

At the peak, traffic was restricted or stopped on five of the city's six road crossings. Kiev authorities now say all bridges are open again, with restrictions applying only during air raid alerts:

➡️The Southern Bridge closes for about 15 minutes after an alert begins, in the direction from the right bank to the left.

➡️The Podolsky bridge crossing closes for about 15 minutes, from the left bank to the right.

➡️The Darnitsky, Northern, Metro and Paton bridges are open without restrictions.

Around a million people live on the eastern bank and commute to the western bank, where most government offices and businesses sit. With drones over the city daily, those alert closures will be frequent.

The NYT concedes the bridges would be hard to bring down, but notes that repeated hits could weaken them enough to force indefinite closure. It also admits that Ukraine is short of air defence and more exposed than at any point in the conflict.
